model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart displays the number of participants who selected each criterion, with the x-axis labeled "Number of Participants" ranging from 0 to 6 in increments of 2, and the y-axis labeled "Criterion" listing seven categories in descending order of participant count. The bars are color-coded and aligned horizontally, with their lengths corresponding to the numerical values shown at the end of each bar. The criterion "Relevant FCs" has the highest count with 6 participants, represented by a dark purple bar. "FC Summary" follows with 5 participants, shown as a dark blue bar. "Relevance Explanation" and "Clarity and Simplicity" each have 3 participants, depicted with medium blue and teal bars, respectively. "Overall Summary" has 2 participants, indicated by a green bar. "Filters" and "Veracity Explanation" each have 1 participant, shown with light green and lime green bars, respectively. The bars are sorted in descending order by the number of participants, and each bar’s value is explicitly labeled at its end. The chart uses a clean, minimal design with no gridlines or additional annotations.
